craptech_swpanel.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechSwitchPanel') if c then c.toggle() end
craptech_swpanel.title: Switch panel: out / in
craptech_swpanel.desc: Turns the dash switch panel out of the dashboard (or back in)

craptech_gsw_1.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechSwitchPanel') if c then c.press(1) end
craptech_gsw_1.title: Switch: air jacks: up / drop

craptech_gsw_2.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechSwitchPanel') if c then c.press(2) end
craptech_gsw_2.title: Switch: wheels: wide / narrow track

craptech_gsw_3.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechSwitchPanel') if c then c.press(3) end
craptech_gsw_3.title: Switch: race kit: out / tucked away

craptech_gsw_4.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechSwitchPanel') if c then c.press(4) end
craptech_gsw_4.title: Switch: wing: out / stowed

craptech_gsw_5.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechSwitchPanel') if c then c.press(5) end
craptech_gsw_5.title: Switch: JATO: deploy / stow

craptech_gsw_6.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechSwitchPanel') if c then c.press(6) end
craptech_gsw_6.title: Switch: hidden flashers

craptech_gsw_7.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechSwitchPanel') if c then c.press(7) end
craptech_gsw_7.title: Switch: rear sign

craptech_firebtn.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechSwitchPanel') if c then c.fire() end
craptech_firebtn.title: JATO: fire / stop (red button)
craptech_firebtn.desc: The big red button behind the shifter: lights or stops the bumper rockets (they must be deployed)
